pro.identity_note: Logical policy identity. Trusted adapter binds the actual visible Pro selector and conversation; no guessed API slug.

luna_low.description: Use GPT-6 Luna at low effort for a narrow, fully specified mechanical edit with clear tests and no unresolved design decision.

luna_high.description: Use GPT-6 Luna at high effort for bounded implementation or debugging with known contracts and a localized verification plan.

astra_high.description: Use GPT-6 Astra at high effort for medium-tough implementation, stateful tool investigation and dense cross-file reasoning under an approved architecture.

opus_medium.description: Use Claude Opus 5.5 at medium effort as a peer for medium-tough multi-file implementation, iterative UI work or compact code with explicit acceptance tests; do not infer superiority from the frontend label alone.

opus_high.description: Use Claude Opus 5.5 at high effort for medium-tough work needing deeper investigation or careful reconciliation; verify concurrency and regressions instead of assuming safety from the model name.

pro_web.description: Use GPT-6 Pro in the case-bound ChatGPT web conversation for tough problems, architecture, research and consequential design, followed by the required independent Claude challenge.

review_fable51.description: Use Claude Fable 5.1 at high effort as the independent reciprocal reviewer of the exact Pro solution, identifying evidence-based counterexamples and revising the shared case.

review_opus55.description: Use Claude Opus 5.5 at high effort as an equally eligible independent reciprocal reviewer of the exact Pro solution, including concrete implementation, interface and concurrency concerns.

effort_question.instructions: What permitted reasoning effort does the next generation require, considering the goal, current evidence and unresolved work?

descriptions.low: Low effort for an authorized mechanical step with no unresolved inference; not merely because the next tool reads a file.
descriptions.medium: Medium effort for a well-constrained implementation step with explicit contracts and ordinary reasoning.
descriptions.high: High effort for difficult interpretation, cross-file interaction, uncertain failure causes or a substantive review.
descriptions.insufficient: Insufficient evidence to change the verified current effort.

lease_question.instructions: For how many model generations is the current effort decision likely to remain appropriate?

criteria.one: One generation: uncertainty, fresh investigation or likely new decision-changing evidence.
criteria.two: Two generations: a bounded short sequence with stable evidence.
criteria.five: Five generations: a predictable sequence under an approved plan.
criteria.ten: Ten generations: repetitive mechanical work with stable scope and no pending uncertainty.
criteria.insufficient: Insufficient evidence for a lease; reassess next generation.

qualification.criteria: Matched task-family evaluation with verified completion, quota, latency, rework, abstention and held-out cases.

defaults_are: Engineering starting points, not universal optima or live deployment receipts
